hypotheses.justification: This instance-implicit variable becomes an argument of `fstDiv_sum` because its type mentions only `q` and `N`, which are already arguments. The statement does not need it. `PlaceSpecialization.fstDiv` is defined in `Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_GlueData.lean` under `[Fact q.Prime] [NeZero N]` only. `PlaceSpecialization` itself also takes only `[Fact ℓ.Prime] [NeZero N]`, and its `Divisor … (modularFunctionFieldBar (N*q))` type has the same requirements. The proof is an induction on `s` that uses `Finsupp.filter_zero`, `Finset.sum_insert` and `fstDiv_add`. `fstDiv_add` is proved with `Finsupp.filter_add` and does not use `hqN` either. The theorem is just additivity of `Finsupp.filter` over a finite sum. It holds without the hypothesis, and the same proof works unchanged. Deleting it, for instance with `omit [hqN] in`, is possible.
